comment: The library table: the interface writer of src/fort/library/interface.ft, the walk of
src/fort/library/tree.ft, the interface file in src/fort/parser.ft and src/fort/modules.ft,
and the shortest decimal of src/fort/flt.ft (D9.11, D18.2, module-system.md 10.3). Each row
breaks one rule that a module test of the stage holds. The module tests compile the mutated
module themselves; the build links the compiler so that the md5 guard reads it. The table
runs in the VM with the default runner after `tools/vm configure` and `tools/vm build`.
On 2026-10-23 all 12 rows were caught, each by the test that the row names in `what`.

stages.name: the library module suites
stages.command: python3 test/lang/run_tests.py --root test/fort --fort build/Linux/debug/fort --std-dir build/Linux/debug/std --verify-ir library/ parser_interface modules_library flt_shortest

mutations.new: return false && name.len > prefix.len && str.starts_with(name, prefix)

an all-zero struct constant is written member by member and not as `{}`
a function of an interface file takes a body
a function of a source file takes `;` for its body
